name: worksheets-ink
does: A Worksheets tab: each document the course's questions come from (SOURCES, a data file listed in course.js `files`; its problem sets from CHAINS when the course has them), under its module, with Write on it (the professor's problems with room to work, written on with a pen, a finger or a mouse: pen, highlighter, eraser, undo, More room, Pencil only, Hold to snap, Show solutions, Save as PDF) and Practice in the drill; under an answer, in the quiz and on an exam's result page, the line "From: <document>, <number> · Worksheet · Original"; Scratch paper beside a calculation's answer box in the quiz and on an exam paper. The writing is kept in the profile's progress (DB.ink), so Export, Import and Erase cover it.
source: Basic-Pharmacokinetics src/views.js WORKSHEETS and Write on a worksheet (lines 5122-5434 and 6040-6322), numericInput's Scratch paper (lines 970-981), kindOf (lines 210-219), the From line (lines 5342-5348, shown at 1735 and 3457), src/shell.html styles (lines 787-808, 813-856, 902-934) and src/ink_test.py, at ac2eb73

label.about: the tab's name in the navigation

before.about: the tab it is placed before

modules.about: [[module value, short name, heading], ...] in teaching order, as the documents' `module` fields spell the value; without it the modules come in the order the documents first name them, headed 'Module <value>'

originalIds.about: a regular expression (source text, no lookbehind) matched against problem set and question ids: a set whose id or every part matches is in the professor's own numbers

changedIds.about: a regular expression matched against question ids: an unnamed set whose parts match is the drill's re-numbered copy, kept as the extra-practice worksheet when a set in the professor's numbers is on the sheet

drillWorked.about: a regular expression matched against a question's audit and note: a match says the drill worked the answer, not the professor's key

spokenOnly.about: a regular expression matched against a question's audit: a match says the working was only heard in the lecture recording ...

writtenWorking.about: ... unless this regular expression matches the audit or the document's note (the working is also written on the professor's sheet)

calcSkills.about: skill ids of COURSE.skills: a matching question of one of these skills whose every pair's answer is a quantity is a calculation, and its part on a worksheet gets the tall work area (Basic-Pharmacokinetics: the skills its course.js marks kind 'calc')
